title: Stop Trying To Lose 1 Pound A Week
hook: Most fitness channels tell you to lose one pound a week. In my opinion, that advice is why most people following it are still fat.
body: If you have 30 pounds to lose, one pound a week takes seven months, and almost nobody stays motivated that long. It's far easier to go all in for 90 days. Make losing fat the number one priority in your life, and fit everything else around it.
close: Save this if you have 30 pounds to lose.
